verses.text: For the music director. To be played on a stringed instrument. Of David. God, hear my cry. Listen to my prayer.
From the ends of the earth I call to you when my heart is weak. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I am.
You have been my safe place, a strong tower against the enemy.
Let me live in your tent forever. Let me find safety in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
God, you have heard my promises. You have given me what belongs to those who respect your name.
Make the king's life long. Let his years go on for generations.
Let him sit on his throne in God's presence forever. Let your faithful love and truth protect him.
Then I will always sing praises to your name as I keep my promises every day.
